text:
aj: Quick question — are we aligned on how error domains map across hosted/dedicated/private? I'm seeing retries bubble up differently.
maria: Not sure, saw one customer case where a private deploy returned 502 then the client retried and hit hosted, causing a double-charge loop :grimace:
kevin: Can you paste the request/response? might be a routing fallback doing model variant swap.
aj: Here's anonymized snippet:
```
{ "error": { "code": "runtime_error", "phase": "adapter", "detail": "kvcache miss + backend OOM" }, "route": "private-eu-1" }
```
olivia: Looks like we don't normalize phase -> domain. hosted treats phase as "proxy" and translates to 5xx while private surfaces "adapter".
kevin: That mismatch is the root cause. SDK retry logic is keyed on HTTP code + domain, so different mappings => inconsistent client behavior.
aj: Proposal: define canonical error_domain values (proxy, runtime, infra, auth) and ensure every hosting mode maps internal phases to them before emitting.
maria: 👍 also think we need a header like x-redwood-error-domain so lb/proxy can short-circuit fallbacks when domain==auth or infra-no-retry.
olivia: +1. For dedicated we should add an operator-configurable mapping because some enterprise installs want different retry surfaces.
kevin: Right — default mapping in control plane, overridden by dedicated/private manifest. Fallback policies must consult domain header, not raw http code.
sre-bot: deploy-bot: canary rollout of error-domain header for hosted starting 2024-09-12 02:00UTC
aj: Operational checklist:
- runtime: emit canonical domain
- proxies: pass x-redwood-error-domain upstream/downstream
- SDKs: update retry logic to check header
- console: surface domain in traces/alerts
maria: I'll own the SDK ticket. @kevin can you own the control-plane mapping + manifest schema change?
kevin: Yup. I'll draft an RFC for schema changes and include a backward-compatible migration plan.
olivia: We'll need tests: cross-mode end-to-end with fallback enabled to verify no double retries. I can add those to chaos tests.
aj: Cool — let's aim to have RFC + SDK PRs by EOW. If anyone needs spec text, I'll sketch the canonical domains and examples.
maria: Thanks — can you add a short sample for "auth" errors? that's the one we must never retry.
aj: Sure, sample:
```
HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized
x-redwood-error-domain: auth
{ "error": { "code":"invalid_token" } }
```
kevin: Nice. Also document operator override rules in control plane.
olivia: one more: ensure logs tag the original phase too (phase=adapter) for debugging, even if we canonicalize domain.
aj: agreed. tagging original_phase and mapped_domain.
maria: thanks all. filing tickets now. :thumbsup:
